display_name: LoRa 原生 8,192 点恢复方向与幅度诊断（Full）
description: Freeze the best native source-selected G and E104. Compare direction vs dose under exact source trace isolation.
authorization: Active LoRa DURA W24 goal authorizes strictly isolated source diagnostics with simulated noise components. Latest user instruction limits this experiment to Full practical.

code.environment: Archived N607 CVS-RFFI with exact registered W24 release

data.representation: Native 8192 complex samples; class scores use W24 8×2×432.
data.contract_ref: Pinned LoRa full packet native IQ contract
data.physical_ids_ref: Exact source V physical rows from 20261127-phase1-lora-raw8192-e104-strong-s2026113011-r01, five RX x 60.
data.validation_ref: lora_full_packets_v1/lora_rx5_main_v1:392005 previously validated and reused. Native parent source freeze and exact direct and original G result parity.
data.leo_config_ref: Full native practical and clean; source-only isolated trace.

permissions.claim_scope: Diagnostic only. One legal source U_s raw packet for real checkpoint smoke and 300 source V packets. Exact source additive simulation noise solely for diagnostic counterfactuals. No parameter updates, target access, threshold or model selection.

sources.role: Same-contract native 18000-step G, originally fixed by source-only rule before formal exposure.

checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Native G source freeze, same matching E104 and exact replay; verified frozen class counts with identical source IDs.
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Original compliant frozen source models, no dynamic weights, no training or calibration.
checkpoint.selection_rule: No candidate selection; confirm one registered source comparison. None of the exact-noise variants are target candidates.

execution.gpu_policy: One N607 physical GPU from [7,2,0,6], >=12 GiB actual free and <8 visible compute contexts, 6 CPU replay workers.
execution.stop_rule: Abort on checkpoint/contract/trace/physical-order or same-dose mismatch, nonfinite output, or direct/native parent parity failure.

metric_names: nonnegative optimal gain for fixed learned direction
parallel fraction of exact W24 center noise
metrics_plan.scorer_ref: experiments.pamf_lora_main.w24_raw_direction_audit score-source and the existing frozen source scorer

rows.method: Direct, frozen native G, best nonnegative scale for learned direction, same-dose exact noise direction, exact removal, exact removal plus learned W24-center orthogonal part.
rows.seed_notes: No training/model seed or support. The 300 source V panel and waveform namespace are reused. Evaluation seed identifies W24 E104.
rows.budget_ref: One source-only frozen 300-packet panel per route; zero parameter updates.

notes: All variants are evaluated with original W24 preprocessing and frozen E104; compare only in the existing Full source V panel.
Matched dose is defined using the RMS of the linear W24 center aperture before original normalization.
The gain-only oracle solves nonnegative least squares to the exact simulated additive noise direction in the linear W24 center.
Exact-plus-learned isolates the part of the native G edit orthogonal to the additive noise in the linear center aperture. Its learned residual is not assumed to be channel correction.
Use the five predetermined pair contrasts and source diagnostic-only noise. No target candidate exists in this run.
